senses.gloss: (onomatop., cmp. חָכַךְ II) [to scratch,] to cough, to bring up mucus.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 99a:16">Erub. 99ᵃ</cite> <he>כָּח בפני רבו</he> (not <cite ref="K00517"><he>כיח</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 16) he who coughs in sight of his teacher, expl.

<cite ref="Eruvin 99a:16">ib.</cite> <he>כח ורק</he> (not <cite ref="K00517"><he>כיח</he></cite>) when he coughs and spits out. Tosef. ib. XI (VIII), 8 <he>הכּוֹחֶה וכ׳</he> (fr. <cite ref="K00456"><he>כָּחַהּ</he></cite>) he who coughs (brings mucus up in his mouth) in the street. Tanḥ. Noah 9 <he>גונח וכוֹהֶה דם</he> coughing and spitting blood; (Tanḥ. ed. Bub. ib. 14 <he>גונח מלבו</he>), v. <cite ref="C01128"><he>גָּנַח</he></cite>.
